## 1. The Conceptual Shift: Moving Frames in Three Dimensions

The 3D Frenet-Serret frame $(\mathbf{T}, \mathbf{N}, \mathbf{B})$ satisfies:
$$\frac{d}{ds} \begin{pmatrix} \mathbf{T} \\ \mathbf{N} \\ \mathbf{B} \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & \kappa & 0 \\ -\kappa & 0 & \tau \\ 0 & -\tau & 0 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} \mathbf{T} \\ \mathbf{N} \\ \mathbf{B} \end{pmatrix}$$
Torsion $\tau(s)$ measures departure from the osculating plane.

---

## 2. Numerical Computation: 3D Space Curve Generator from Curvature and Torsion

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}
## Python 3
```python
import numpy as np

def integrate_helix(k: float = 0.5, tau: float = 0.2, s_max: float = 10.0, n: int = 500):
    ds = s_max / n
    T = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]); N = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]); B = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0])
    r = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    for _ in range(n):
        dT = k * N; dN = -k * T + tau * B; dB = -tau * N
        T += dT * ds; N += dN * ds; B += dB * ds
        T /= np.linalg.norm(T)
        r += T * ds
    return r

r_final = integrate_helix()
print(f"Python 3: Final Position = ({r_final[0]:.3f}, {r_final[1]:.3f}, {r_final[2]:.3f})")
```

## C++20
```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <array>

int main() {
    int n = 500;
    double s_max = 10.0, ds = s_max / n;
    double k = 0.5, tau = 0.2;
    std::array<double, 3> T{1, 0, 0}, N{0, 1, 0}, B{0, 0, 1}, r{0, 0, 0};

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::array<double, 3> dT{k*N[0], k*N[1], k*N[2]};
        std::array<double, 3> dN{-k*T[0] + tau*B[0], -k*T[1] + tau*B[1], -k*T[2] + tau*B[2]};
        std::array<double, 3> dB{-tau*N[0], -tau*N[1], -tau*N[2]};

        for(int j=0; j<3; ++j) {
            T[j] += dT[j]*ds; N[j] += dN[j]*ds; B[j] += dB[j]*ds;
            r[j] += T[j]*ds;
        }
    }
    std::cout << "C++20:    Final Pos = (" << r[0] << ", " << r[1] << ", " << r[2] << ")\n";
    return 0;
}
```

## Julia
```julia
n = 500; ds = 10.0 / n; k = 0.5; tau = 0.2
T = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]; N = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]; B = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
r = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]

for _ in 1:n
    dT = k .* N; dN = -k .* T .+ tau .* B; dB = -tau .* N
    global T += dT .* ds; global N += dN .* ds; global B += dB .* ds
    global r += T .* ds
end
println("Julia:    Final Pos = $(round.(r, digits=3))")
```

## Modern Fortran
```fortran
program space_curve
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 500
  integer :: i
  real(8) :: ds, k, tau
  real(8) :: T(3), N(3), B(3), r(3), dT(3), dN(3), dB(3)

  ds = 10.0d0 / n; k = 0.5d0; tau = 0.2d0
  T = [1.0d0, 0.0d0, 0.0d0]
  N = [0.0d0, 1.0d0, 0.0d0]
  B = [0.0d0, 0.0d0, 1.0d0]
  r = 0.0d0

  do i = 1, n
    dT = k * N
    dN = -k * T + tau * B
    dB = -tau * N
    T = T + dT * ds
    N = N + dN * ds
    B = B + dB * ds
    r = r + T * ds
  end do

  print '(A,3F7.3)', "Fortran:  Final Pos = ", r
end program space_curve
```

## MATLAB / Octave
```matlab
n = 500; ds = 10 / n; k = 0.5; tau = 0.2;
T = [1; 0; 0]; N = [0; 1; 0]; B = [0; 0; 1];
r = [0; 0; 0];

for i = 1:n
    dT = k * N;
    dN = -k * T + tau * B;
    dB = -tau * N;
    T = T + dT * ds;
    N = N + dN * ds;
    B = B + dB * ds;
    r = r + T * ds;
end
fprintf('MATLAB:   Final Pos = (%.3f, %.3f, %.3f)\n', r(1), r(2), r(3));
```
